tax.text: Stratton calls for a middle-class tax cut funded by raising taxes on people earning more than $1 million a year, alongside expanded programs like Medicare for All.
tax.quote: Passing a Tax Cut for the Middle Class, Paid for with a Tax Increase on those Making More than a Million Dollars a Year

wages.text: Stratton supports raising the federal minimum wage to $25 an hour, saying the current $7.25 is not a living wage.
wages.quote: PASS A FEDERAL $25 LIVING WAGE. Americans know that $7.25 an hour isn't a living wage.

immigration.text: Stratton calls for abolishing ICE and supports a pathway to citizenship and stronger protections for immigrants.
immigration.quote: ICE must be abolished. It is out of control and beyond reform.

guns.text: Stratton touts banning assault weapons and campaigns on passing common-sense gun safety laws.
guns.quote: We've raised the minimum wage, protected reproductive freedom, banned assault weapons, invested in our education, rebuilt roads and bridges, created thousands of jobs, and the list goes on.

abortion.text: Stratton campaigns on restoring Roe v. Wade protections and lists protecting reproductive freedom among her accomplishments.
abortion.quote: We've raised the minimum wage, protected reproductive freedom, banned assault weapons, invested in our education, rebuilt roads and bridges, created thousands of jobs, and the list goes on.

health.text: Stratton supports Medicare for All to guarantee every American access to health care.
health.quote: That's why I support Medicare for All. We must act and ensure every single American has access to the healthcare they deserve.

voting.text: Stratton says she would support the John Lewis Voting Rights Act to restore and strengthen voter protections.
voting.quote: I would proudly support the John Lewis Voting Rights Act to restore and strengthen voter protections, ensuring our democracy represents all Americans.

tax.text: Tracy's campaign platform calls for cutting spending and letting families keep more of their earnings.
tax.quote: Cut wasteful spending, improve efficiency, and help families keep more of what they earn.

safety.text: Tracy says he backs law enforcement and holding violent criminals accountable.
safety.quote: Support law enforcement, hold violent criminals accountable, and put public safety first.

immigration.text: Tracy calls for securing the border and enforcing immigration law while welcoming legal immigrants who follow the rules.
immigration.quote: Secure the border. Enforce the law. Welcome legal immigrants who play by the rules.

health.text: Tracy calls for price transparency and more competition to reduce health care costs.
health.quote: Promote price transparency, more competition, and reforms that help reduce insurance and prescription costs.

energy.text: Tracy calls for an energy policy that uses available sources and lowers household costs.
energy.quote: Support a reasonable energy policy that uses available energy sources, protects reliability, and reduces household costs.
